paite: TOUPA, David haksat thuaknate tengteng theihpih in;
heading: Tempul Phatna

paite: TOUPA kiang a kichiam a, Jakob Mihatpa kiang a thu achiamdan;
"Ka omna inn a biakbuk ah ka lut kei dia, ka lupna ah ka kah sam kei ding hi.
Ka mitte ihmut ka phal kei ding a, ka mitte asin uh leng ka phal sam kei ding,
TOUPA mun ding ka zonkhiak masiah, Jakob Mi Hatpa omna ding," chi in.
Ngai in, athu Ephrathah ah ka za ua; sing gam ah ka muta uhi.
Amah biakbuk ah ka lut ding ua; akhe ngakna bul ah ka be ding uhi.
TOUPA aw, thou inla, na khawlmun ding ah lut in; nang leh na hatna bawm.
Na siampute diktatna in kivan uhenla; na misiangthoute nuamsa in kikou uhen.
Na sikha David ziak in na thaunilh mel kiheisak nawn ke'n.
David kiang ah thutak in TOUPA akichiamta a; alehngatsan kei ding hi; "Na pumpi gah a mi laltutphah ah ka tusak ding.
Na tate'n ka thukhun leh ka thu theihsak, amau ka hilh ding azuih uleh, atate uh leng tangtawn in na laltutphah ah atu zel ding uh," chi in.
TOUPA'N Zion lah atel ngal a; a-omna ding in adeih hi.
Hiai tangtawn a ding a ka khawlmun ding ahi; hiai ah ka om nilouh ding; ka deihlam ahi ngal a.
Anek ding tampi in ka vualzawl dia; amigentheite uh tanghou in ka taisak ding hi.
Asiampute hotdamna in ka van ding a; amisiangthoute nuamsa in akikou ding uhi.
Huai ah David kii ka selkhesak ding; ka thaunilh a ding in khawnvak ka septa hi.
Amah doute zahlakna in ka van ding a, amah tung ah zaw alallukhu ate sengsung ding, chi in.
